question: 一共有多少个用户？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM users

question: 一共有多少个订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders

question: 每个城市的用户数量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM users GROUP BY city

question: 总销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(qty * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items

question: 销售额最高的商品是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS name, SUM(o.qty * o.unit_price) AS total FROM order_items o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

question: 每个商品类别的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(o.qty * o.unit_price) AS total FROM order_items o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total DESC

question: 2026年9月22日至9月28日每天的订单数量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT created_at, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-09-22' AND '2026-09-28' GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY created_at

question: 有多少订单已被取消？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = '已取消'

question: 广州用户的订单总数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.city = '广州'

question: 平均每笔订单包含几件商品？
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(qty) AS cnt FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: 价格最贵的商品叫什么？
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: 每个用户的订单数量，按订单数从高到低排列
gold_sql: SELECT u.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY n DESC
